title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab EE versions from 19.5 up to but not including 19.5.6 allowed an authenticated user to start a Duo Workflow session with elevated privileges beyond those intended. This issue was due to improper enforcement of privilege boundaries in certain client environments. The vulnerability has been remediated in version 19.5.6.
